contributionMap.claim: At every fixed Gram rank d, both normalised moments of every non-trivial irreducible Schur-power block tend to zero as n grows, uniformly over shapes and inputs; so Lieb's ordinary-immanant inequality and Lavi's quadratic inequality hold at each fixed rank for all n >= n_0(d) (threshold not computed)
